liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): The performance peaked during the 68-minute jam of these four songs; This is cited as the best version of this jam ever heard [29][34][40]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): The jam sequence is highlighted as extremely well done [33]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-10-14.150969.sbd.eaton-latvala.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1983-10-14.153345.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 182 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1983-10-14.165105.mtx.photolean.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 185 min [3]
- **gd1983-10-14.163913.nak304.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 182 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd83-10-14.beyer-ficca-brennan.ficca.20023.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 171 min; rated 4.21/5 by 28 [18]. Said about its sound: The audience tape is described as fantastic, very clear, and well-placed; The audience recording is praised for its high quality and clarity; The audience recording is preferred for its fuller feel and energy [30][33][38][40]

## Around the show

- Listeners sat front row, about 15 feet from the band, with tight security [29]
- The band played Day Job on consecutive nights, which frustrated some fans [31]
- The reviewer recalls seeing Jerry Garcia alive once at a 1994 show [35]
- This tape is considered superior to the Dick's Picks 6 soundboard [38]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-10-14.150969.sbd.eaton-latvala.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Original Transfer and Mastering by Rob Eaton Additional Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 29, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master > DAT (Panasonic SV-3700/44.1k) > DAT (Panasonic SV-3800) [1]. Also: Rob Eaton and Dick Latvala provided the source for this recording [1]
- **gd1983-10-14.153345.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: source: Matrix by Dave Usborne [2]. Also: Rob Eaton recorded the audience tape, and Charlie Miller handled transfers [2]
- **gd1983-10-14.165105.mtx.photolean.flac1644**: transferred by Matrix created in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel October 05, 2022; source: A photoLeon Matrix [3]. Also: John Ficca recorded with Beyer M160 mics; Tim Friend and Joe Morrone used Nakamichi CM300 [3]
- **gd1983-10-14.163913.nak304.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 shotgun capsules > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [5]
- **gd83-10-14.beyer-ficca-brennan.ficca.20023.sbeok.shnf**: source: Ficca FOB Sony TCD5M with 2 Beyer Dynamic 160's->Sony CDR-W66>EAC>CDWave>CD via Ficca [18]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bobbie Bestic Grateful Dead: [1983-10-15 Hartford Civic Center, Hartford, CT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-10-15-hartford-civic-center-hartford-ct-usa/) [42]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Hartford Civic Center - October 14, 1983](https://www.dead.net/show/october-14-1983) [43]
